text: 14.	On April 18, 2014, an avalanche in the Khumbu Icefall on X killed 16 Ys who were fixing ropes and ferrying supplies. It was the deadliest single-day disaster in X’s history up to that point (later surpassed in 2015 by an earthquake-triggered avalanche that killed 22). The tragedy reignited debate about the risks borne by Ys compared to their wealthy customers, with a typical Y earning $3,000-5,000 from all customers they serve in a season, while a single typical customer pays $30,000-100,000 for a trip. In the aftermath of the disaster, the surviving Ys went on strike and the rest of the 2014 season on X was effectively cancelled. ID X (7 points) and Y (8 points).
